description:
Land Acquisition - Eerikewa and Millawewa, Nuwaragampalatha Central D/S/D, Anuradhapura District
Amendment, Ex Gazette No - 2431/14 of 09.04.2025
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their extents, boundaries, and locations. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" classification (Type 4). The mention of the minister is incidental to the authorization of the land notice and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
